notes: Refer to SGGEE site search which shows Anna Dorothea Zelmer to be the daughter of Gottlieb Zelmer and Rosine Dorothea Goering.  Anna Dorothea is shown as SGGEE person number i79221 and born around 1826 in Lasinska, Kolonia, Slupca,Poznan, Poland.  Her sibling is shown as Krystyan (Christian) Zelmer person # 1108204 born about 1819 and his wife to be Maria Krueger.
